versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the reframe-video skill for converting videos to a new aspect ratio without cropping the subject.
- Uses AI to extend scene edges by outpainting, rather than trimming or cropping.
- Supports specifying target aspect ratio, desired surroundings for the extension, and custom source positioning.
- Workflow built on Luma Ray 3.2 model for live video inference; requires confirmation of supported resolutions and schema.
- Provides detailed prompting and technique guidance to ensure subject preservation and seamless scene extension.
